subject: Request: Credit concession for 50-GPU reserved pool (Nimbus AI)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan@starlithealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal for 50-GPU reserved pool — draft SOW attached

Jordan —

Thanks again for the run-through this morning. Per our conversation I’m attaching a draft SOW for a 12-month reserved pool sized to match your 50-GPU peak (RTX-A800 equivalent). Key bullets:
- Guaranteed baseline throughput: 18k tokens/sec across pooled instances (90th pct SLA target)
- Burst capacity: +20% for seasonal peaks, with pre-agreed throttling policy
- Data separation: dedicated tenancy, audit logs forwarded to your SIEM

Pricing summary (monthly committed): $115k/mo for the 50-GPU pool, billed monthly over 12 months. I’ve also attached the usage baseline you shared so we can reconcile estimates.

Jordan, you mentioned a competing proposal — if you can share their quote I’ll see what flexibility we have on credits for the first two months while you ramp.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Proposed_SOW_50GPU_12mo.pdf
Attachment: usage_baseline.csv

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan@starlithealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposal for 50-GPU reserved pool — draft SOW attached

Logan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. Appreciate the clarity on burst and logs. We are evaluating two other providers; one has a competing reserved offering at $98k/mo for a 12-month commit and is also offering a 2-month upfront credit plus onboarding credits. That proposal is attached.

Two asks from our side to make Redwood the preferred vendor:
1) Match the 2-month credit (or provide equivalent onboarding credits)
2) Agree to a 30-minute SLA review call after month 1 with ops to validate throughput numbers

If you can bring an executive concession on the credit, I can push this to procurement next week.

—Jordan
Dir. of Platform Engineering, Starlit Health
jordan@starlithealth.com

Attachment: competitor_quote.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.inference, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Nimbus AI — request for 2-month onboarding credit to match competitor (details + ask)

Team —

Need quick guidance / exec approval for a credit concession on the attached deal (NIM-2027-07). Summary:
- Customer: Starlit Health (Nimbus AI) — wants 50-GPU reserved pool, 12 months
- Our proposed price: $115k/mo. Competitor quote attached showing $98k/mo + 2-month credit.
- Ask from customer: either match competitor price/credit or provide equivalent 2-month onboarding credit + SLA review post-launch.

Options I’m proposing for approval:
A) Provide $230k credit (2 months) if they sign 12-month commit at $115k/mo (non-refundable, applied over first two invoices) — preserves list price while offering ramp assistance
B) Offer $100k one-time onboarding credit + 6-week free support package (engineer-led runbook) — smaller cash impact, higher services uplift
C) Decline and offer expedited onboarding with 30% discount on first-month overage buffer only

Attached: Proposed_SOW_50GPU_12mo.pdf, competitor_quote.pdf, usage_baseline.csv

Ask: Vivek / Marissa — can we get a sign-off for Option A or B? This is strategic (potential upsell to Dedicated+Private for their medtech customers). If you need more detail I can jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Logan

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference

Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Nimbus AI — request for 2-month onboarding credit to match competitor (details + ask)

Logan / Vivek —

Thanks for the context. I’m supportive of offering a credit here given the strategic nature (healthcare vertical, potential private deployment). A couple of thoughts:
- Option A preserves list price for reporting and is simple from a billing standpoint; risk is perceived discounting.
- Option B gives us a services-led approach that increases touchpoints and reduces pure revenue loss — lean toward B if ops can commit to the runbook.

Vivek — given their potential to expand into Private (higher ACV), I can recommend up to $140k in onboarding credits (one-time) if you can sign off. Anything above that would need EVP approval.

Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole@redwood.inference
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Nimbus AI — request for 2-month onboarding credit to match competitor (details + ask)

Team —

Reviewed the numbers. Given the strategic signal and short sales cycle, I approve Option B up to $140,000 one-time onboarding credit + 6-week services package, provided we include these guardrails:
- Credit applied one-time on the first invoice and claw-back clause if customer terminates within 90 days
- Commit language added: 12-month irrevocable commit with 30-day termination notice only for force majeure
- SLA review call scheduled at week 4 post-launch; ops to provide throughput validation report

Logan — you’re cleared to communicate this to Jordan. Treat this as final; anything beyond requires EVP (Simon) sign-off.

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference

Jordan —

Thanks for sharing the competitor quote. We took this to leadership and I can confirm Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit of $140,000 plus a 6-week engineer-led runbook to accelerate cutover. Terms: credit applied to first invoice with a 90-day claw-back if the contract terminates within that period; 12-month committed term required. If that works I’ll circulate the final SOW and a short addendum that captures the credit and claw-back clause for signature. Appreciate the quick collaboration — we’re excited to partner.

Best,
